title: n8n before 2.41.4 and 2.42.x before 2.42.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows low-privileged…
description: A prototype pollution vulnerability exists in n8n versions before 2.41.4 and in 2.42.x versions before 2.42.1. This flaw allows low-privileged users to manipulate built-in object behavior by saving workflows with specially crafted connection keys such as __proto__. The vulnerability causes server errors during the periodic history compaction task, leading to login failures and write operation disruptions.
